name: rtx
_comment_rtx: RTX 5060 Ti (sm_120, 16 GB) on host. Model-agnostic head (#481 Phase 2c). Serves all SOLO/PIPELINE/COMBINED requests. For COMBINED (dense-27b-combined), borrows rtx3060 as the layer-split peer (slots reserved exclusively during the request). For SOLO (moe-35b-solo), runs the Q3_K-mini 35B-A3B on its own. Resident model is whatever was last requested via PREFILL inline reload (#479/S3) — see preset-rtx5060ti.ini. The per-model config (split_mode, tensor_split, override_tensor, rpc_servers) is in models.json engine_config keyed by the routing identity (e.g. moe-35b-solo, dense-27b-combined).

name: rtx3060
_comment_rtx3060: RTX 3060 (sm_86, 12 GB) on host. Model-agnostic peer-only (#481 Phase 2c). slots=0 means MultiEngineRouter treats it as implicitly available for COMBINED — no solo work, no model load from Core. The 5060 Ti (rtx) is the only Core-facing head; rtx3060 is driven by the head engine over its own RPC (localhost:9504). Resident model is whatever the 5060 Ti pushed via the layer-split plan in PREFILL hydra_config — see preset-rtx3060.ini for the per-quant preset the engine advertises. Two-mode: (a) idle — no resident model. (b) COMBINED 27B peer — reserved exclusively by the 5060 Ti.

name: p100
_comment_p100: Tesla P100 (sm_60, 16 GB) KVM VM at 192.168.122.21. P/D decode fallback for moe-35b-pd / moe-35b-pd-mix / moe-35b-pd-mini. Single-model mode (--model /mnt/readonly_data/...gguf), not router mode. The 5060 Ti head reaches the P100 via rpc_servers: ['p100:9502'] in models.json engine_config (Phase 2b). Leave prefill_model_name / decode_model_name / router_model_name UNSET so the inline-reload path is skipped on this worker.
